This tabulation indicates very little change in the current availability. There are fewer purchase units indicated in the above tabulation due to the smaller survey area. There are sufficient units available. Although there are no one bedroom units in this survey area, there are enough two bedroom units in the same price range. The turnover projected in the original plans would indicate that the turnover would be the same for this combined plan.
The potential problems would remain the same since the two parcels deleted in this plan were not considered to be possible problems.
There is no change in the commercial displacement on the two proposed projects.
There is no change in the concurrent displacement, as indicated in the original plans.
